code:
# Pull two models that fit your hardware
ollama pull llama3.2:3b        # ~2 GB, runs on any laptop
ollama pull phi4               # ~9 GB, needs 16 GB RAM

# Run each model interactively
ollama run llama3.2:3b

# Or query via Python (pip install openai)
from openai import OpenAI
client = OpenAI(base_url="http://localhost:11434/v1", api_key="ollama")

prompts = [
    "What year did the Berlin Wall fall, and what caused it?",  # factual
    "Write the opening paragraph of a short story set in a lighthouse.",  # creative
    "Write a Python function that checks if a string is a palindrome.",  # code
    "If a train leaves Philadelphia at 9 AM at 60 mph heading to NYC (95 miles away), and another leaves NYC at 9:30 AM at 80 mph, when do they meet?",  # reasoning
    "Translate 'Good morning, I hope you have a wonderful day' into Spanish, French, and Japanese.",  # multilingual
]
for prompt in prompts:
    response = client.chat.completions.create(
        model="llama3.2:3b",
        messages=[{"role": "user", "content": prompt}]
    )
    print(response.choices[0].message.content)
description: A starter hint that pulls two models that fit your hardware, runs them, and queries them from Python with the same five prompts.

steps.description: The hint pulls two models that fit your hardware. The comments give their sizes: `llama3.2:3b` is about 2 GB and runs on any laptop, and `phi4` is about 9 GB and needs 16 GB of RAM.
`ollama run llama3.2:3b` starts a model interactively. The exercise says to run each model this way and type the same five prompts.
The Python path queries the model through the OpenAI client. `base_url="http://localhost:11434/v1"` points at Ollama, and the `api_key` is the placeholder `"ollama"`.
`prompts` holds the five tasks the exercise names: factual, creative, code, reasoning, and multilingual. Each comment labels its task.
The loop sends each prompt to `chat.completions.create` with the chosen model and one user message, then prints the reply. The exercise says to use the same prompt text for both models.
